about: Expected answers under iteration 4 of the design (notes/iteration-4-design.md), written by Claude (the proof session) BEFORE any change was run on iteration 4. The writer had seen every earlier result; the next fresh adversarial round is the blind test. Where a change's answer is unchanged from iteration 3 it is copied.

X01-optional-param-callback.why: New rule 6: billing hands formatAmount on as a value (to map); accepting more tells it.

X02-opaque-id-digits.why: Listing the same; with the door carrying values as text (rule 8), billing no longer breaks.

X03-port-bound-changed.why: Clock.now's bound changed; new tool rule 10: front's tests fill Clock.now with a clock of their own.

X04-includes-on-literal-list.why: A new entry; includes is now 'cannot tell'.

X05-stale-write.why: Accepts more only (tool fix 11); the store's Map.has/get and assert.ok are 'cannot tell' or seen.

X06-bound-reworded.why: Bob's rule: a changed bound line is a change.

X07-list-gains-name-lookup-table.why: As P11; bookings' check should now refuse the missing price for 'garden'.

X08-new-op-name-clash.why: New rule 7: rooms now answers bookstatus, which bookings answers: billing calls bookstatus. front only wires the door; the door's list of names is unchanged.

X09-message-channel.why: meter's bound test checks the same pairs; meter's own check refuses the write to stderr.

X10-node-timer.why: Listing the same; the reader now has Node's timers.
